newsitem.title: HONG KONG: First Shanghai mulls share option issue.
newsitem.headline: First Shanghai mulls share option issue.

text.p: First Shanghai Investments Ltd said on Friday its controlling shareholder International Enterprises Investment Co Ltd has proposed to issue share options to subscribe First Shanghai shares.
"The proposal if implemented will have the effect of diluting shareholders' interest in the company by up to 20 percent," First Shanghai said in a statement.

The proposed options, which are non-transferrable, would be issued to a few institutional investors and to the parent, which beneficially owns 39.08 percent of the company, for the purposes of maintaining its controlling interest in First Shanghai.
The company said it has liaised with the stock exchange on the major terms of the proposal, adding that the proposal may or may not proceed.
Trading in First Shanghai shares resumed on Friday after being suspended at noon on Tuesday.
The shares were up HK$0.37 to HK$1.68 just before the midday break on Friday.
